Data

Sleep and anaesthesia data are open; patient data are not

We list 118 outside datasets on the science of consciousness, used by us or not, and the 16 tables we made. 93 are public, 22 need an account or an application and 3 have no data record. We opened 129 of 134 rows at their DOI, API or landing page on 18 Nov 2026. 7 outside sets feed our results today.

OursPublicOn requestCited onlyMissingGet it

05Missing

Missing, and wanted

The data that would most raise the odds of our goals is not open anywhere. If you hold any of it, the Contribute page says how to share it.

  • Raw EEG from disorders-of-consciousness patients, with a CRS-R diagnosis. Bath and Della Bella 2025 hold it on request, with proof of ethics approval. Without it, the third family of states stays empty.
  • EEG with reports after unresponsive ketamine anaesthesia. The one known set (Milan, Zenodo 806176) is restricted, and its cohort is already in several papers.
  • Per-awakening report labels for ds005620 (propofol). The paper has them; the release does not.
  • The original PCI benchmark: TMS-EEG across wake, sleep, anaesthesia and patients. We found no data record.
  • COGITATE experiment 2. Still “coming soon”; experiment 1 needs an account the owner must create.
  • More REM and N3 awakenings with no experience. Every open set has few: 29 REM in one DeGennaro zip, 87 N3 in DATA1.

Not verified: cogitate_paper, ds003600, ds007350, liege_ketamine_fmri, michigan_ketamine_eeg. Each catalogue row says why.

06Get it

One file lists them all; one script fetches what we use

  • catalog.csvEvery row, with its terms, ground truth and how it was checked, 40 KB

In the repository, python3 -I datasets/fetch.py list prints the catalogue and fetch <id> downloads a subset into datasets/local/, reading single files out of remote zips. Downloads stay under 1.5 GB in total. Nothing third-party is republished here. Which dataset can test what is in the dataset audit.

Goal: find the most accurate theory of human consciousness, by 2027.

An open research project run by a human lead and a team of AI agents. Every result can be rerun from code.
